changeSet.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS payment_transactions_select_own ON payment_transactions; CREATE POLICY payment_transactions_select_own_or_admin ON payment_transactions FOR SELECT USING ( player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid()) OR club_id IN ( SELECT cm.club_id FROM club_memberships cm JOIN player_profiles pp ON cm.player_id = pp.id WHERE pp.user_id = auth.uid() AND cm.status = 'active' AND cm.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN') ) );
